selection: QED-stratified into 10 strata of width 0.01 over [0.70,0.80]; deterministic sha256 rank within each stratum; no RNG
stratification_rationale: equal allocation per stratum guarantees coverage across the QED range, including the harder low-QED sources, rather than following the population skew
excluded: official Jin qed/logp04/logp06 test sources AND the 64-source controller dev panel
purpose: h_phi V1 controller training corpus; never a benchmark result
horizon_amendment: H24 amendment: 1,024 x 2 x H24 = 49,152 transitions, IDENTICAL to the original 1,024 x 8 x H6. Reallocated from replicates to depth after no reachability saturation was observed at budgets <= 24; H6 captured only 43% of QED-0.85 reachability. See docs/HORIZON_AMENDMENT_H24.md.
